features.title: Money held, not sent
features.description: Your payment goes into escrow, not directly to the seller. It is only released when you confirm delivery.

features.title: Visible status at every step
features.description: Follow your transaction through clear states — funded, shipped, delivered, confirmed, released — with references you can copy.

features.title: 72-hour confirmation window
features.description: After delivery, you have 72 hours to confirm receipt or raise a dispute. No pressure to respond instantly.

features.title: Simple dispute filing
features.description: Pick a reason, add evidence, and our team reviews within 48 hours. Refunds go back to your original payment channel.

features.title: Fraud protection cues
features.description: Assurra will never ask for your PIN or BVN by phone or email. We keep the platform safe so you can shop safely.

features.title: Works on slow networks
features.description: Data-saver mode keeps Assurra light and fast, even on small data bundles and patchy connections.
